name: dile-components
tagline_zh: 写 <dile-input> 总记不住属性？CRUD 页面拼到崩溃？这个 Skill 直接给你组件用法。
tagline_en: Tired of guessing <dile-input> props or wrestling CRUD? This Skill hands you component APIs, icon names, and.
desc_en: Use when building or modifying UI with the Dile Components library (@dile/ui, @dile/crud, @dile/editor, @dile/utils, @dile/lib, @dile/iconlib, @dile/icons) — a framework-agnostic, Lit-based web component catalog. Trigger when installing/importing dile-* custom elements, using tags like <dile-input>, <dile-modal>, <dile-table>, building CRUD screens, adding a WYSIWYG/Markdown editor, using icon com
why_zh: 同类工具只给列表，它连图标名和 CRUD 模板都备好，还懂 @dile/editor 的坑，省得你踩。
why_en: Others list components; this one includes icon names, CRUD templates, and @dile/editor gotchas—so you skip the trial-and-error.
